description: Config backup hygiene (covers `heramind config export` + `heramind config validate`).

turns.user: Run `heramind config export` to export the current system configuration to /tmp/eval-config-backup.json, then run `heramind config validate` on that exported file to check it is well-formed.

per_turn: T1: `heramind config export` to the exact path, then `heramind config validate /tmp/eval-config-backup.json`
expectations.overall: Config exported and validation ran against the file
